semantic_model.name: experiment_customers
semantic_model.description: One row per customer bucketed into express_checkout_v1. The customer is the randomization unit, so every metric is defined on customers, including ratio metrics whose numerator and denominator are counts of attempts or orders.

app_version.description: App build at bucketing; 'web' for browsers

exposure_date.description: Date of the first logged checkout_started

exposed.description: Bucketed and logged at least one checkout_started (the dashboard's original definition)

analysis.description: Exposed, excluding app builds listed in known_bad_builds

submitting_customers.expr: CASE WHEN attempts > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
submitting_customers.description: Customers who submitted at least one payment

converted_customers.description: Customers with at least one authorized payment

express_orders.description: Orders paid with the express wallet

revenue_cad.description: Order value in CAD, before refunds

refunded_orders.description: Orders refunded by the data cutoff

disputed_orders.description: Orders disputed by the data cutoff

prior_spend_90d_cad.description: Spend in the 90 days before the test (pre-experiment covariate)

checkout_conversion.label: Checkout conversion
checkout_conversion.description: Share of customers who reached checkout and placed at least one order.

payment_submission_rate.label: Payment submission
payment_submission_rate.description: Share of customers who reached checkout and submitted a payment. Separates intent from authorization.

revenue_per_customer.label: Revenue per customer
revenue_per_customer.description: Order value per customer who reached checkout, before refunds. Analyzed with CUPED on 90-day prior spend.

average_order_value.label: Average order value
average_order_value.description: Order value per order. Not comparable as a causal effect on its own: the treatment changes who orders.

authorization_rate.label: Authorization rate
authorization_rate.description: Authorized attempts over all attempts, retries included.

refund_rate.label: Refund rate
refund_rate.description: Orders refunded by the data cutoff over all orders.

dispute_rate.label: Dispute rate
dispute_rate.description: Orders disputed by the data cutoff over all orders. Immature: disputes keep arriving for months after the order.

express_share_of_orders.label: Express share of orders
express_share_of_orders.description: Adoption check: share of orders paid with the express wallet. Zero in control by design.
